sourceManifest.elevationDefinition: Bilinear samples in source CRS at every original/clipped geometry vertex and <=25m interpolation spacing. Sum positive/negative changes, no per-delta suppression. Horizontal meters use haversine; heights are estimated NAVD88 meters.
sourceManifest.name: Cascades trail network

methodology: Fresh process, ephemeral loopback HTTP server and real search worker for each query; no live app is contacted.
RSS includes server, worker threads and in-process HTTP measurement client; browser and coordinator memory are excluded. Sampling can miss peaks; OS high-water and sample gaps are also recorded.
Route timing is first API observation with 100ms polls, not exact discovery time. Reconnect checks the current-search API, not browser rendering.
The observation window and sampled RSS guard only stop this measurement through the app Stop API. An outer deadline kills a hung child after the window plus 15 seconds.
Query criteria are frozen; historical pilot dataset IDs/start counts do not describe the supplied snapshot. Counts are retained app choices, not independent existence certificates.
Each result records the effective query, including app defaults for newer settings absent from the frozen request. Explicit requested constraints must remain unchanged.
Timing is descriptive; filesystem caches and concurrent machine activity are uncontrolled. Failed or interrupted observations do not prove no matches.
scope: Compact record of the completed 24-case run. Per-second timelines and duplicate snapshots omitted; effective queries, observed status/progress, sampling gaps, memory, Stop, reconnect and process outcomes retained. This measures behavior, not independent route quality.

qualifications: One fresh-process HTTP observation per unchanged frozen request. App defaults add maximum 1609.344 walked road meters and 0.1 road fraction; this policy changes the feasible set versus earlier no-road-limit diagnostics.
30 seconds is the measurement window, not an application time limit. Unfinished searches and no observed options do not certify route absence.
Counts are retained app options under current selection behavior, not route-quality or independent source-completeness proof.
RSS covers the app process including server, worker and measurement client, not the browser or coordinator. 20ms samples can miss peaks; OS high-water is also recorded.
Filesystem caches and machine load are uncontrolled. Integrator manual UI activity and documentation work may have run concurrently. No cold-cache or isolated-machine timing claim.

priorWitnessEligibility.scope: Inherited pilot witnesses are not automatically eligible on the replacement snapshot. This is a partial audit, not a revalidation of all 24 expectations.

eligibility.reason: The same source start is now unknown, while the unchanged query excludes unknown access. This excludes the frozen witness independently of road limits.
eligibility.currentFrozenWalkRoadLimitEligibility: not replayed; overall eligibility already false at start
eligibility.otherParadiseReplay: paradise-day is a different walk and start with different constraints; it is not an oracle for paradise-known.

paradise-known.scope: Read-only start-eligibility diagnosis using existing saved measurements and source evidence. No solver, build or download. Zero predates track correction and new road limits; it does not establish absence of real hikes.

priorWitnessEligibility.middle-fork-day: The fixed prior witness remains in the network but has 3021.281 m (20.5323%) of roads/tracks, exceeding both defaults. See network-review.json fixedWitnessRoadShares; the two current retained options are different routes.
